judgement.summary: This is a detailed, scientifically careful portfolio plan built around an unfolding calibration protocol and Iris’s specific held-back reference check. Its greatest weakness is that the three proposed concepts largely repeat the same seven-part document arrangement and methodological sequence rather than offering substantially different directions.
